    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
    s.log_average_luminance = std::exp(host_sum / static_cast<float>(n));
    s.exposure              = settings.key / s.log_average_luminance;

    // 2. white point from the luminance histogram
    std::uint32_t *bins = arena.allocate<std::uint32_t>(n);
    std::uint32_t *hist = arena.allocate<std::uint32_t>(prims::kHistogramBins);
    launch_linear(luminance_bins_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, s.exposure, bins);
    prims::histogram256(bins, n, hist, arena, stream);
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(s.histogram.data(), hist, sizeof(std::uint32_t) * prims::kHistogramBins, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
    prims::inclusive_scan(hist, hist, prims::kHistogramBins, arena, stream);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> cdf(prims::kHistogramBins);
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(cdf.data(), hist, sizeof(std::uint32_t) * prims::kHistogramBins, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));

    const double target = settings.white_percentile * static_cast<double>(n);
    std::uint32_t white_bin = prims::kHistogramBins - 1;
    for(std::uint32_t b = 0; b < prims::kHistogramBins; ++b)
    {
        if(static_cast<double>(cdf[b]) >= target)
        {
            white_bin = b;
            break;
        }
    }
    // upper edge of the bin
    const float log2_white = kHistogramMinLog2 + (white_bin + 1) * (kHistogramMaxLog2 - kHistogramMinLog2) / 256.f;
    s.white_point          = std::fmax(std::exp2(log2_white), 1e-3f);

    // 3. tone map
    launch_linear(tonemap_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, true, s.exposure, 1.f / (s.white_point * s.white_point), out);
}
} // namespace tsr
// Tessera - the hybrid splat + mesh renderer.
#include "tsr/prims/prims.h"
#include "tsr/render/renderer.h"

namespace tsr
{
namespace
{
constexpr std::size_t kInitialArenaBytes = std::size_t{4} << 20;

__global__ void visible_flags_kernel(std::uint32_t n, const int2 *__restrict__ radii, std::uint32_t *__restrict__ flags)
{
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if(i < n)
    {
        const int2 r = radii[i];
        flags[i]     = (r.x > 0 && r.y > 0) ? 1u : 0u;
    }
}
} // namespace

Renderer::Renderer(const RenderSettings &settings) : settings_(settings), arena_(kInitialArenaBytes)
{
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
}

Renderer::~Renderer()
{
    if(stream_ != nullptr)
    {
        cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_);
        cudaStreamDestroy(stream_);
    }
}

void Renderer::set_scene(const Scene &scene)
{
    gaussians_.upload(scene.gaussians, stream_);
    mesh_.upload(scene.meshes, stream_);
    if(mesh_.n_faces > 0)
    {
        material_.initialize(scene.material, stream_);
    }
    background_ = scene.background;
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
    has_scene_ = true;
}

void Renderer::render_surface(const Camera &camera)
{
    const int W    = static_cast<int>(camera.width);
    const int H    = static_cast<int>(camera.height);
    mesh_overflow_ = false;
    if(mesh_.n_faces == 0)
    {
        clear_surface(W, H, background_, surface_, stream_);
        fragments_ = MeshFragments{};
        return;
    }
    transform_faces(mesh_, camera, faces_, stream_);
    bin_mesh_faces(faces_, W, H, settings_.mesh_binning, mesh_bins_, arena_, stream_);
    mesh_overflow_ = mesh_bins_.overflowed;
    rasterize_mesh_fine(faces_, mesh_bins_, W, H, settings_.mesh_raster, fragments_, stream_);
    shade_surface(material_, fragments_, faces_, camera, background_, surface_, arena_, stream_);
}

std::uint32_t Renderer::count_visible_splats()
{
    const std::uint32_t n = splats_.count;
    if(n == 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    std::uint32_t *flags = arena_.allocate<std::uint32_t>(n);
    std::uint32_t *total = arena_.allocate<std::uint32_t>(1);
    launch_linear(visible_flags_kernel, n, stream_, n, splats_.radii.data(), flags);
    prims::reduce(flags, n, total, prims::ReduceOp::Sum, arena_, stream_);
    std::uint32_t host_total = 0;
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&host_total, total, sizeof(host_total), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
    return host_total;
}

Frame Renderer::render(const Camera &camera)
{
    TSR_CHECK(has_scene_, "Renderer::render called before set_scene");
    TSR_CHECK(camera.width > 0 && camera.height > 0, "camera has an empty image");
    arena_.reset();

    // opaque surface layer
    render_surface(camera);

    // splats
    project_gaussians(gaussians_, camera, settings_.projection, splats_, stream_);
    compute_splat_colors(gaussians_, camera, splats_, stream_);
    bin_splats(splats_, camera, settings_.binning, binning_, arena_, stream_);

    // composite
    rasterize_splats(splats_, binning_, surface_, camera, settings_.splat_raster, composite_, stream_);

    // post
    const std::size_t n_pixels = static_cast<std::size_t>(camera.width) * camera.height;
    ldr_.resize(n_pixels);
    Frame frame;
    frame.width  = static_cast<int>(camera.width);
    frame.height = static_cast<int>(camera.height);
    tonemap(composite_.color.data(), frame.width, frame.height, settings_.tonemap, ldr_.data(), &frame.stats.tonemap, arena_, stream_);

    frame.stats.visible_splats       = count_visible_splats();
    frame.stats.intersections        = binning_.n_isects;
    frame.stats.surface_pixels       = surface_.covered_pixels;
    frame.stats.mesh_bins_overflowed = mesh_overflow_;
    frame.linear                     = composite_.color.to_host(stream_);
    frame.alpha                      = composite_.alpha.to_host(stream_);
    frame.rgba8                      = ldr_.to_host(stream_);
    frame.stats.scratch_bytes        = arena_.high_water();
    return frame;
}
} // namespace tsr

void NeuralMaterialModel::initialize(const NeuralMaterial &desc, Stream stream)
{
    desc_ = desc;
    grid_.initialize(desc.grid, desc.seed, kGridInitScale, stream);
    mlp_.initialize(grid_.n_output_dims(), 3, desc.mlp, desc.seed ^ 0x5bd1e995u, stream);
}

void clear_surface(int width, int height, float3 background, SurfaceLayer &out, Stream stream)
{
    const auto n       = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(width * height);
    out.width          = width;
    out.height         = height;
    out.covered_pixels = 0;
    out.color.resize(n);
    out.depth.resize(n);
    launch_linear(fill_surface_kernel, n, stream, n, background, out.color.data(), out.depth.data());
}

void shade_surface(
    const NeuralMaterialModel &material,
    const MeshFragments &fragments,
    const ViewFaces &faces,
    const Camera &camera,
    float3 background,
    SurfaceLayer &out,
    Arena &arena,
    Stream stream
)
{
    clear_surface(fragments.width, fragments.height, background, out, stream);
    const auto n = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(fragments.width * fragments.height);
    const int K  = fragments.faces_per_pixel;

    std::uint8_t *flags = arena.allocate<std::uint8_t>(n);
    launch_linear(flag_hits_kernel, n, stream, n, K, fragments.pix_to_face.data(), flags);
    std::uint32_t *pixels = arena.allocate<std::uint32_t>(n);
    const std::uint32_t m = prims::compact_indices(flags, n, pixels, arena, stream);
    out.covered_pixels    = m;
    if(m == 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    const NeuralMaterial &desc = material.desc();
    const float3 extent        = desc.bounds_max - desc.bounds_min;
    TSR_CHECK(extent.x > 0.f && extent.y > 0.f && extent.z > 0.f, "material bounds must have positive extent");
    const float3 inv_extent = make_float3(1.f / extent.x, 1.f / extent.y, 1.f / extent.z);

    float3 *unit_positions = arena.allocate<float3>(m);
    launch_linear(
        fragment_positions_kernel, m, stream, m, pixels, K, fragments.pix_to_face.data(), fragments.bary.data(),
        faces.world.data(), desc.bounds_min, inv_extent, unit_positions
    );

    const std::uint32_t enc_dims = material.grid().n_output_dims();
    float *encoded               = arena.allocate<float>(static_cast<std::size_t>(m) * enc_dims);
    encode_positions(material.grid(), unit_positions, m, encoded, GridInterpolation::Linear, stream);

    float *rgb = arena.allocate<float>(static_cast<std::size_t>(m) * 3);
    material.mlp().forward(encoded, m, rgb, arena, stream);

    launch_linear(
        scatter_surface_kernel, m, stream, m, pixels, K, fragments.pix_to_face.data(), fragments.zbuf.data(),
        fragments.bary.data(), faces.world.data(), faces.normals.data(), rgb, camera.position(), desc.tint,
        out.color.data(), out.depth.data()
    );
}

// Tessera - exposure and tone mapping of the linear composite.
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

#include "tsr/math/vec.h"
#include "tsr/post/tonemap.h"
#include "tsr/prims/prims.h"

namespace tsr
{
namespace
{
constexpr float kLumEpsilon = 1e-4f;

TSR_HDI float luminance(const float3 &c) { return 0.2126f * c.x + 0.7152f * c.y + 0.0722f * c.z; }

TSR_HDI float srgb_encode(float x)
{
    x = fminf(fmaxf(x, 0.f), 1.f);
    return x <= 0.0031308f ? 12.92f * x : 1.055f * powf(x, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
}

TSR_HDI unsigned char to_unorm8(float x) { return static_cast<unsigned char>(fminf(fmaxf(x, 0.f), 1.f) * 255.f + 0.5f); }

__global__ void log_luminance_kernel(std::uint32_t n, const float3 *__restrict__ hdr, float *__restrict__ log_lum)
{
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if(i < n)
    {
        log_lum[i] = __logf(kLumEpsilon + luminance(hdr[i]));
    }
}

__global__ void luminance_bins_kernel(std::uint32_t n, const float3 *__restrict__ hdr, float exposure, std::uint32_t *__restrict__ bins)
{
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if(i >= n)
    {
        return;
    }
    const float L = luminance(hdr[i]) * exposure;
    if(L <= 0.f)
    {
        bins[i] = 0;
        return;
    }
    const float t = (__log2f(L) - kHistogramMinLog2) / (kHistogramMaxLog2 - kHistogramMinLog2);
    bins[i]       = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(fminf(fmaxf(t * 256.f, 0.f), 255.f));
}

__global__ void tonemap_kernel(
    std::uint32_t n,
    const float3 *__restrict__ hdr,
    bool enabled,
    float exposure,
    float inv_white_sq,
    uchar4 *__restrict__ out
)
{
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if(i >= n)
    {
        return;
    }
    float3 c = hdr[i];
    if(enabled)
    {
        c             = c * exposure;
        const float L = luminance(c);
        // extended Reinhard: L (1 + L / Lw^2) / (1 + L)
        const float Ld = L * (1.f + L * inv_white_sq) / (1.f + L);
        c              = L > 0.f ? c * (Ld / L) : make_float3(0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    }
    out[i] = make_uchar4(to_unorm8(srgb_encode(c.x)), to_unorm8(srgb_encode(c.y)), to_unorm8(srgb_encode(c.z)), 255);
}
} // namespace

float linear_to_srgb(float x) { return srgb_encode(x); }

float srgb_to_linear(float x)
{
    x = std::fmin(std::fmax(x, 0.f), 1.f);
    return x <= 0.04045f ? x / 12.92f : std::pow((x + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f);
}

void tonemap(
    const float3 *hdr,
    int width,
    int height,
    const TonemapSettings &settings,
    uchar4 *out,
    TonemapStats *stats,
    Arena &arena,
    Stream stream
)
{
    const auto n = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(width * height);
    if(n == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    TonemapStats local;
    TonemapStats &s = stats != nullptr ? *stats : local;
    s               = TonemapStats{};

    if(!settings.enabled)
    {
        launch_linear(tonemap_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, false, 1.f, 1.f, out);
        return;
    }
    TSR_CHECK(settings.white_percentile > 0.f && settings.white_percentile <= 1.f, "white percentile must be in (0, 1]");

    // 1. exposure from the log-average luminance
    float *log_lum = arena.allocate<float>(n);
    float *sum     = arena.allocate<float>(1);
    launch_linear(log_luminance_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, log_lum);
    prims::reduce(log_lum, n, sum, prims::ReduceOp::Sum, arena, stream);
    float host_sum = 0.f;
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&host_sum, sum, sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
    s.log_average_luminance = std::exp(host_sum / static_cast<float>(n));
    s.exposure              = settings.key / s.log_average_luminance;

    // 2. white point from the luminance histogram
    std::uint32_t *bins = arena.allocate<std::uint32_t>(n);
    std::uint32_t *hist = arena.allocate<std::uint32_t>(prims::kHistogramBins);
    launch_linear(luminance_bins_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, s.exposure, bins);
    prims::histogram256(bins, n, hist, arena, stream);
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(s.histogram.data(), hist, sizeof(std::uint32_t) * prims::kHistogramBins, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
    prims::inclusive_scan(hist, hist, prims::kHistogramBins, arena, stream);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> cdf(prims::kHistogramBins);
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(cdf.data(), hist, sizeof(std::uint32_t) * prims::kHistogramBins, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
    TSR_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));

    const double target = settings.white_percentile * static_cast<double>(n);
    std::uint32_t white_bin = prims::kHistogramBins - 1;
    for(std::uint32_t b = 0; b < prims::kHistogramBins; ++b)
    {
        if(static_cast<double>(cdf[b]) >= target)
        {
            white_bin = b;
            break;
        }
    }
    // upper edge of the bin
    const float log2_white = kHistogramMinLog2 + (white_bin + 1) * (kHistogramMaxLog2 - kHistogramMinLog2) / 256.f;
    s.white_point          = std::fmax(std::exp2(log2_white), 1e-3f);

    // 3. tone map
    launch_linear(tonemap_kernel, n, stream, n, hdr, true, s.exposure, 1.f / (s.white_point * s.white_point), out);
}
} // namespace tsr

// Tessera - small deterministic random number generator (PCG32).
//
// Used to initialize neural parameters and to build synthetic scenes, so the
// sequence must be identical on every platform: no std:: distributions.
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace tsr
{
class Pcg32
{
public:
    explicit Pcg32(std::uint64_t seed = 0x853c49e6748fea9bULL, std::uint64_t stream = 0xda3e39cb94b95bdbULL)
    {
        state_ = 0u;
        inc_   = (stream << 1u) | 1u;
        next_uint();
        state_ += seed;
        next_uint();
    }

    std::uint32_t next_uint()
    {
        const std::uint64_t old = state_;
        state_                  = old * 6364136223846793005ULL + inc_;
        const auto xorshifted   = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(((old >> 18u) ^ old) >> 27u);
        const auto rot          = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(old >> 59u);
        return (xorshifted >> rot) | (xorshifted << ((~rot + 1u) & 31u));
    }

    // Uniform in [0, 1) with 24 bits of precision.
    float next_float() { return static_cast<float>(next_uint() >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f); }

    float uniform(float lo, float hi) { return lo + (hi - lo) * next_float(); }

    // Uniform integer in [0, bound).
    std::uint32_t next_bounded(std::uint32_t bound)
    {
        const std::uint32_t threshold = (~bound + 1u) % bound;
        while(true)
        {
            const std::uint32_t r = next_uint();
            if(r >= threshold)
            {
                return r % bound;
            }
        }
    }

private:
    std::uint64_t state_;
    std::uint64_t inc_;
};

} // namespace tsr

{"command":"cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Tessera

Tessera is a hybrid Gaussian-splat and triangle-mesh renderer.  Its complete
rendering pipeline uses standard OpenMP target offload and has both accelerator
and host-device implementations.

## Build

Use Clang 18 or newer:

```sh
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
  -DTSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH=sm_89
cmake --build build -j
ctest --test-dir build
```

For a host offload device, leave `TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH` empty and configure with
`-DTSR_OFFLOAD_TARGETS=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu`.  A plain `-fopenmp` CPU fallback
build is selected when both settings are empty.

Options:

* `TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH`: accelerator architecture passed to Clang's offload driver.
* `TSR_OFFLOAD_TARGETS`: target triple used when no architecture is selected.
* `TSR_BUILD_TESTS`: build tests (default `ON`).
* `TSR_BUILD_APPS`: build `tsr_render` (default `ON`).

Run `tsr_render --help` for the command-line renderer. Scene syntax is described
in `docs/scene_format.md` and the rendering stages in `docs/architecture.md`.
EOF
rm -f docs/emulated_backend.md src/encode/mlp.cpp.tmp
sed -i 's/\.cuh/\.h/g; s/\.cu/\.cpp/g' THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs/architecture.md
# atomic overflow
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/bin/mesh_bins.cpp';s=open(p).read();s=s.replace('if(pos<M)list[(std::size_t)bin*M+pos]=f;else *overflow=1;','if(pos<M)list[(std::size_t)bin*M+pos]=f;else {\n#pragma omp atomic update\n overflow[0]|=1;\n }');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
# Remove local generated builds, including forbidden old source artifacts.
rm -rf build_cuda build_host build_omp build_testhost
# Static scan production names/content
find . -path './.git' -prune -o -path './tests' -prune -o \( -name '*.cu' -o -name '*.cuh' \) -print
grep -RInE 'cudaStream_t|TSR_CUDA|__global__|__device__|__host__|<<<|>>>|CUDAToolkit|cudart|enable_language\(CUDA|ompx_|__nvvm|__builtin_nvvm|TSR_BACKEND_EMU|device/emu|fiber' include src apps cmake CMakeLists.txt || true
git status --short | tail -80"}

project(tessera VERSION 0.7.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

option(TSR_BUILD_TESTS "Build the test suite" ON)
option(TSR_BUILD_APPS "Build command line tools" ON)
set(TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH "" CACHE STRING "OpenMP GPU offload architecture (for example sm_89)")
set(TSR_OFFLOAD_TARGETS "" CACHE STRING "OpenMP target triples used when TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH is empty")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Tessera OpenMP target offload requires clang++ 18 or newer")
endif()

if(TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH)
  set(TSR_OMP_FLAGS -fopenmp -fopenmp-targets=nvptx64-nvidia-cuda --offload-arch=${TSR_OFFLOAD_ARCH})
elseif(TSR_OFFLOAD_TARGETS)
  set(TSR_OMP_FLAGS -fopenmp -fopenmp-targets=${TSR_OFFLOAD_TARGETS})
else()
  # A host-only build is still an OpenMP implementation and is useful as the
  # CPU fallback.  OMP_TARGET_OFFLOAD controls whether fallback is permitted.
  set(TSR_OMP_FLAGS -fopenmp)
endif()

include(cmake/TesseraDevice.cmake)
add_subdirectory(src)
if(TSR_BUILD_APPS)

  render/renderer.cpp
  post/tonemap.cpp
  scene/scene.cpp
  io/image.cpp
  sched/frame_scheduler.cpp
)


add_library(tessera SHARED ${TSR_DEVICE_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(tessera PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(tessera PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

function(tsr_target_offload target)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE ${TSR_OMP_FLAGS} -ffp-contract=fast)

endfunction()

  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Wno-unused-parameter)
endfunction()
